merge_request.description:

## What does this MR do and why?

Split grouping into shown and hidden

To mirror the 'metadata visibility' UX, this change applies the same split list change to the group visibility settings in the display drawer.

Relates to https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/work_items/613526

-description: 'Fires when a user changes which columns are shown on the work item planning board or changes their order, covering five actions carried in label: show_group and hide_group for toggling a single column, hide_all_groups for the "Hide all" action, and reorder_drag or reorder_menu depending on how a column was moved. The hide_group action covers both the display settings toggle and the "Hide list" action in the column header menu. It does not fire when "Hide all" is used but every column is already hidden, or when a reorder resolves to no change, such as the same index or a move off the end of the row. The column or status name is never sent, because status names are customer-defined data.'
